description: three att.datable forms: (R1) a point in time via @when, resolved into prop::DATE with tei:date-attr="when"; (R2) a one-sided bound via @notBefore alone, resolved the same way with tei:date-attr="notBefore" so a reader can tell it's a bound rather than a point; (R3) @notBefore+@notAfter present TOGETHER express a two-point RANGE that does not fit prop::DATE's single year/month/day Map at all - this is the documented design fork (see TODO.md): it is NOT resolved into prop::DATE, and is instead demoted to a misc bibliography_field with both raw dating attributes preserved, so nothing is silently dropped
